messages.subject: Your office computer
messages.body:
Detective,

Your computer is finally working.

Mail is for correspondence. Personal Ledger is for your own money, not the agency budget. Classifieds is where people advertise jobs they would rather not explain to the police.

Please stop using the keyboard as a coaster.

Holly

messages.subject: The printer is not haunted
messages.body:
Dear tenant,

The printer is not haunted. It prints at night because somebody keeps sending documents to it.

We are investigating why those documents are dated next Thursday.

Building Management

messages.subject: An invoice for services not yet rendered
messages.body:
Dear Detective,

Please find no attachment.

You will understand the amount when the time comes.

Do not pay anyone claiming to be me. Especially me.
